# Update Model Database

Updates the local model database with the latest models from HuggingFace Hub.

## Usage
- Fetches the latest model metadata and rankings from HuggingFace
- Updates local model registry with new models and version changes
- Validates checksums and compatibility before updating entries
- Supports filtering by task type, framework, and license
